title: Merge Cubes 2048 3D
description: A completely new approach to the classic game 2048! Now in 3D and with dynamic physics! The cubes with numbers dont just merge - they bounce and collide, adding an element of surprise to every game! Compete with friends or colleagues!
instructions: 1 At first it will be easy to connect the cubes but over time there will be more and more of them Once you connect the biggest cube in this game it will disappear
